name: Onewo Inc.
summary: Onewo Inc. provides property management services in the People's Republic of China. It offers residential property services, including cleaning, security, gardening, and repair and maintenance services to property owners, property owners' associations, or residents for residential properties, as well as home-related asset services comprising home sale and rental brokerage, and home redecoration and furnishing services.
